status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned

constraints: for every horse: 0 <= P1 <= PTop2 <= PTop3 <= 1
within every race: sum(P1)=1, sum(PTop2)=2, sum(PTop3)=3
coherentProjection.algorithm: deterministic alternating Euclidean projections: project every horse 3-vector onto the nondecreasing isotonic cone, then project each of the three race columns onto a bounded [0,1] simplex with its required sum; repeat 50 times or until maximum constraint error <1e-10

quinellaProxy: for unordered pair A,B: firstA*secondOnlyB + secondOnlyA*firstB; normalize all pair proxies in a race to mass 1
wideProxy: for unordered pair A,B: sum of position-component products over distinct positions among first/secondOnly/thirdOnly; normalize all pair proxies in a race to mass 3
officialPairCorrection: multiply the JRA official pair-market probability by modelProxy/marketProxy, clip the ratio to [0.25,4.0] to prevent numerical domination, then renormalize to the original race mass (1 quinella, 3 wide)
ticketScore: corrected pair probability multiplied by corresponding JRA official odds; wide uses official lower bound for ranking
rankingEvaluation: actual JRA top1/top3/top5/top9 return rates over the full chronological fixed archive and the four OOS blocks
